items.title: Vesalio appoints Daniel Davis to board of directors and advisor to chief executive officer
items.summary: Vesalio has announced the appointment of Daniel Davis to its board of directors and as advisor to the chief executive officer (CEO).

items.title: MRI-guided TULSA for localised prostate cancer provides “excellent” functional preservation, yet warrants “contextualisation”
items.summary: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)-guided transurethral ultrasound ablation (TULSA) has demonstrated “excellent” technical feasibility and minimal major morbidity for localised prostate cancer in a recent systematic review and meta-analysis led by Arsalan Nadeem (Allama Iqbal Medical College, Lahore, Pakistan).

items.title: Endovascular Engineering receives two US FDA 510(k) clearances for PE thrombectomy devices
items.summary: Endovascular Engineering (E2) has announced that the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has granted 510(k) clearance for both the Hēlo thrombectomy system and Hēlo Return (blood return system).

items.title: IR provides ‘most efficient’ liver cancer care compared to other specialties, study finds
items.summary: Interventional radiologists provide patients with primary and secondary liver cancer with high-quality, high-impact care in a more cost-efficient way than other specialties, according to a retrospective study published in the Journal of Vascular and Interventional Radiology (JVIR).

items.title: AngioDynamics appoints Eric Honroth as president and chief executive officer
items.summary: AngioDynamics has announced the appointment of Eric Honroth as president and chief executive officer and a member of the board of directors, effective 2 November 2026. Honroth will succeed Jim Clemmer, who will depart the board on the same date but will remain in a consulting capacity.

items.title: Innova Vascular’s Laguna thrombectomy system meets primary endpoints in pivotal pulmonary embolism study
items.summary: Innova Vascular has announced positive results from the pivotal TRUST study, which evaluated the Laguna thrombectomy system for the treatment of pulmonary embolism (PE). The data were presented at the Vascular InterVentional Advances (VIVA) conference (4–7 October, Las Vegas, USA).

items.title: STORM-PE subset analysis demonstrates correlation between clinical assessments and real-world functional recovery
items.summary: Penumbra has announced results from a subset analysis of the STORM-PE randomised controlled trial (RCT), which, according to the company, is the first trial to demonstrate a significant correlation between real-world, daily step-based activity as captured on a consumer wearable device and patient performance in the…

items.title: Shape Memory Medical receives ANVISA market authorisation for Impede embolisation plug family in Brazil
items.summary: Shape Memory Medical has announced that Brazil’s national health surveillance agency, ANVISA (Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária), has granted authorization for the Impede embolisation plug, the Impede-FX embolisation plug, and the Impede-FX RapidFill.

items.title: Sirolimus-coated balloon angioplasty associated with lower one-year TLR rate in SirPAD secondary analysis
items.summary: Among patients with femoropopliteal artery disease and no tissue loss, angioplasty with the MagicTouch PTA sirolimus-coated balloon (Concept Medical) was associated with a lower one-year rate of target-lesion revascularisation (TLR) compared with uncoated balloon angioplasty in a secondary analysis of the SirPAD…

items.title: IR “most utilised” specialty for HCC, finds 25-year multidisciplinary analysis
items.summary: “This work highlights how central interventional radiology [IR] has become in the multidisciplinary care of patients with hepatocellular carcinoma [HCC].

items.title: Endologix rebrands as Rhevera Medical
items.summary: Endologix Holdings has announced Rhevera Medical as its new corporate brand—an updated identity that reflects the company’s broader commitment to partnering with physicians who treat complex vascular disease, and supporting patients whose lives, mobility and independence depend on the company’s technologies, as stated…

items.title: AMA assigns new CPT codes for renal denervation
items.summary: The American Medical Association (AMA) has approved two new category I current procedural terminology (CPT) codes describing renal denervation.

items.title: Inquis Medical launches “first” thrombectomy catheter with full 360-degree directional aspiration for PE
items.summary: Inquis Medical has announced the US commercial launch of its latest Aventus catheter, which is designed to provide physicians with 360-degree sweeping directional aspiration for clot removal within the vasculature.

items.title: Medtronic receives US FDA Breakthrough Device designation for IN.PACT BTK drug-coated balloon
items.summary: Medtronic has received US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Breakthrough Device designation for its IN.PACT below-the-knee (BTK) drug-coated balloon.

items.title: Kidney-sparing embolization reduces patient risks of acute injury and death compared to surgery, study finds
items.summary: A new study finds that embolization greatly reduces the risk of acute kidney injury and in-hospital mortality compared to nephrectomy when treating initially stable trauma patients with high-grade kidney injuries. The study was published in the Journal of Vascular and Interventional Radiology (JVIR).

items.title: CIRSE announces first patients enrolled in ORACLE and RESCUE studies of chronic limb-threatening ischaemia
items.summary: The Cardiovascular and Interventional Radiological Society of Europe (CIRSE) has announced the start of patient enrolment in ORACLE and RESCUE, two prospective observational studies designed to generate real-world evidence on endovascular interventions for patients with chronic limb-threatening ischaemia (CLTI).

items.title: First patients enrolled in CIRSE’s ORACLE and RESCUE studies of chronic limb-threatening ischaemia
items.summary: The Cardiovascular and Interventional Radiological Society of Europe (CIRSE) has announced the start of patient enrolment in ORACLE and RESCUE, two prospective observational studies designed to generate real-world evidence on endovascular interventions for patients with chronic limb-threatening ischaemia (CLTI).

items.title: Mölnlycke launches Biogel radiation protection gloves to reduce clinician hand exposure during procedures
items.summary: Mölnlycke Health Care US announced today the launch of a new surgical glove range designed to reduce clinician hand exposure to scattered radiation during fluoroscopy-guided, interventional and other image-dependent procedures.

items.title: Texray appoints Ziv Haskal to advisory board
items.summary: Texray has announced that interventional radiologist Ziv J Haskal (University of Virginia School of Medicine, Charlottesville, USA) has joined the company’s clinical and scientific advisory board.

items.title: More interventional radiologists practicing primarily in their specialty, new study finds
items.summary: Interventional radiology (IR) has continued to grow as a distinct, clinically oriented specialty, according to a new study published in the Journal of Vascular and Interventional Radiology (JVIR).
